dialogues.speaker: Billboard
dialogues.text: "Mushroom Pizza, Sautéed Matsutake, and Chicken-Mushroom Skewer... It's all about mushrooms."

dialogues.speaker: Billboard
dialogues.text: "Let alone the nutrition in them! They are absolute gold for your health!"

dialogues.speaker: Billboard
dialogues.text: "For anyone who's reading this sign to see the beauty of mushrooms, I've put one by the sign. Please help yourself."

dialogues.speaker: Billboard
dialogues.text: "I hope you'll come to love mushrooms too."
